caption: The drawing features a tall, rectangular wooden clock with two main sections placed on four small, rounded feet. The upper section contains a circular clock face with black Roman numerals and two hands, set against a colorful floral background dominated by shades of blue, green, yellow, and pink. Surrounding the clock face is a border filled with intricate leaf and flower patterns. The wooden casing is a reddish-brown color, and the sides of the clock also show a lattice or fretwork design. At the top, there is an ornate pediment with scroll details and a gold eagle finial. The lower section is larger and includes a painted rectangular panel bordered by a design similar to the clock face, with green and pink floral motifs at the corners. The panel depicts a scenic landscape: a building or castle to the left, a figure in robes standing on the right, some trees, and a large yellow sun or moon near the center in the sky. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details.
title: Mantel Clock
